gloss: to pose (a question); to cast (a glance, a shadow); to throw at

definitions.gloss: to pose (a question, an issue); to direct toward
definitions.explanation: Figurative use: to direct a question, doubt, or topic at someone or at the public. The most common modern usage.

definitions.gloss: to cast (a glance, a smile, a shadow)
definitions.explanation: To send out something intangible — a look, expression, or light/shadow — in a particular direction.

definitions.gloss: to throw toward; to hurl at
definitions.explanation: Literal sense: to throw an object in someone's direction. Less common than the figurative senses in modern usage.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧ (to throw) + かける (to direct toward, to apply). Modern usage is dominated by the figurative senses (questions, glances, shadows) — the literal throwing sense is now uncommon and ⟦{投|な}げつける→投げつける：15621_nagetsukeru⟧ is more idiomatic for hostile throwing.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. The target takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, the object takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧:
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投|な}げかける: to pose an issue to society
- ⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{視線|しせん}→視線：14138_shisen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投|な}げかける: to cast a glance at the audience

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{疑問|ぎもん}→疑問：02648_gimon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投|な}げかける: to raise a question
- ⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投|な}げかける: to pose a question
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投|な}げかける: to raise an issue
- ⟦{視線|しせん}→視線：14138_shisen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投|な}げかける: to cast a glance
- ⟦{影|かげ}→影：02191_kage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投|な}げかける: to cast a shadow

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧: to throw — basic literal throwing
- ⟦{投|な}げつける→投げつける：15621_nagetsukeru⟧: to throw at — hostile, hurled with force
- ⟦{問|と}いかける→問いかける：12002_toikakeru⟧: to ask of — narrower, used only for questions
